notes_list.title: Sandmeyer Reaction
notes_list.basic_overview: Aryl diazonium salts are converted into aryl chlorides, bromides or nitriles using copper(I) salts such as CuCl, CuBr or CuCN.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
ArN2+ can be replaced by Cl, Br or CN. Example: aniline → diazonium salt → chlorobenzene using CuCl. Nitrogen gas leaves during the transformation.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The aryl diazonium ion undergoes copper(I)-mediated replacement with loss of nitrogen, installing Cl, Br or CN depending on the copper salt.
